title: Acceptance of Medical Certificates Issued by Ministry-approved TCM Physicians
what_it_is: Acceptance of Medical Certificates Issued by Ministry-approved TCM Physicians

sections.label: TCM practitioners and medical certificates
sections.summary: TCM practitioners can be registered under MRA, and employers may recognise their MCs for paid sick leave beyond Employment Act minimums.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Traditional Chinee Medicine (TCM) practitioners can also be registered, if they fulfil the requirements of MRA.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Before April 2019, employers were only required to recognise MCs if they were issued by a Government or company-appointed medical practitioner.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: I should add that employers are free to go beyond the minimum provisions in the Employment Act and recognise TCM practitioners' MCs for the purposes of granting paid sick leave.

sections.label: MRA-registered practitioners and valid MCs
sections.summary: Over 4,000 practitioners are registered under MRA, and the Employment Act has long required MCs to be issued by MRA-registered practitioners.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: We have to take it in a broader context.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: There are more than 4,000 medical practitioners that are registered under MRA.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: People may consult TCM practitioners for any number of reasons, but the fact that the Employment Act requires MCs to be issued by an MRA-registered practitioner in order to be valid has been known for quite a long time.

sections.label: Section 15 of MRA
sections.summary: Section 15 of MRA states MCs required by written law are valid only if signed by a registered person with a valid practising certificate.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: If I may quote to the Member, section 15 of MRA states that "no medical certificate or other document required by any written law to be signed by a duly qualified medical practitioner shall be valid unless signed by a person who is registered under the Act and has a valid practising certificate".

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: But like I said, if employers would like to recognise TCM medical certificates, they are certainly free to do so.
